[[File:Servez-vous de ma thèse.jpg|thumbnail|Information is quite readily available in our days, but are you willing to consider all the information accessible to you?]]
'''The widening context''' refers to the increasing quantity and diversity of information accessible to human beings, as a result of scientific progress and [[globalisation]].

== Impact ==

According to ''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]'', the widening context can be a source of [[intellectual division]]. In modern days, the number of perspectives and facts a human being is willing/capable of considering is only a fraction of what is available to them. [[Individual bias]]es lead the human being to select consciously and differently from other human beings, contributing to different understanding and interpretation of the same issue.
